subject: Post-call: discovery recap + PoC readiness and next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Wu <emma.wu@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: discovery recap + PoC readiness and next steps

Thanks again for your time today, Emma — good conversation. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Key pain points you shared
- Latency on live patient triage models is causing delays in routing (current 450–600 ms p95 for short prompts).
- Cost on peak hours is spiking due to naive batching and no prefix caching.
- Data residency requirement for PHI: must host inference in a dedicated VPC or private deployment for production.

Current stack and constraints
- Frontend: React + server-side Node (AWS us-west-2)
- Model hosting today: internal TF endpoints for smaller models; looking to move to a hosted inference solution for larger LLMs
- Security: SOC2 in progress; need KMS integration and audit logs for any PoC handling PHI

Success criteria for a PoC (as I captured)
1) < 200 ms p95 for short triage prompts in the PoC environment
2) 30–40% token cost reduction vs current naive setup via batching/caching
3) Demonstrate encrypted-in-flight and KMS-backed key management for PoC data flow
4) Clear runbook for moving to a Dedicated VPC for production

Proposed PoC scope & timeline
- Duration: 4 weeks (pilot + 1 week buffer)
- Week 1: infra setup (VPC, KMS access), SDK integration (Node + Python examples)
- Week 2: baseline runs and tuning (batching + cache config)
- Week 3: low-latency configuration and A/B of quantized model variant
- Week 4: run acceptance tests, export logs and cost report

Owners (Redwood)
- Ben Carter (AE) — overall coordination, weekly checkpoints
- Priyom Das (Solutions Eng) — SDK onboarding, latency tuning, quantization tests
- Marissa Cole (Customer Success) — acceptance criteria, runbooks, rollout plan

Immediate asks for clarity from your side
- Confirm PoC owner on Clarity Health (technical lead + procurement contact).
- Which SDK languages do you want first? I suggested Node + Python; do you need Java/Go?
- Any regulatory docs we should attach up front (SOC2 cert, DPA)?

Attachments: redwood-poc-sow-v1.pdf (sample SOW), sdk-compatibility-matrix.csv

Next call: propose Tue 2027-03-16 10:00 AM PT for PoC kick-off — does that work?

Thanks — happy to adjust scope.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Emma Wu <emma.wu@clarityhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@clarityhealth.com>, procurement@clarityhealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: discovery recap + PoC readiness and next steps

Ben — thanks for the thorough recap. All looks accurate from our side. A couple of clarifications and notes: 

1) PoC owner: I'll be the technical lead (Emma Wu). Carlos Mendes (cc'd) will own procurement/contract.
2) SDKs: Node first (we have a small Node microservice that will call the inference endpoint). Python for offline tests would be helpful later. No immediate need for Java/Go.
3) PHI handling: we need to confirm the KMS workflow and whether logs can be routed to our S3 with server-side encryption. Please include those details in the SOW.
4) Timeline: the 4-week plan looks reasonable. For acceptance testing we will use a sample set of 120 triage prompts and a latency target of p95 < 230 ms in the PoC env (we can be flexible if quantization changes accuracy).

I've added procurement@clarityhealth.com for contract routing — Carlos, can you confirm budget window and whether we need an MSA or an amendment to our existing supplier agreement?

Tue 2027-03-16 10:00 AM PT works for our team.

Thanks,
Emma
Principal Technical Product Manager
Clarity Health
emma.wu@clarityhealth.com | (312) 555-8890

Great — thanks Emma and Carlos for the confirmations. A few short action items before the kick-off tomorrow: 

Action items (owner / due)
- Carlos (procurement@clarityhealth.com): share SOW comments or preferred contract template by Thu 2027-03-18 EOD
- Emma (technical lead): share a minimal sample dataset (anonymized) and the 120 triage prompts by Wed 2027-03-17 EOD
- Priyom (Redwood): prepare Node SDK quickstart (example serverless handler + auth snippet) and a checklist for KMS integration by tomorrow
- Marissa (Redwood CS): produce acceptance checklist and a short runbook for switching to Dedicated VPC post-PoC

Meeting link (kick-off): https://meet.redwood.ai/ben/clarity-poc-kickoff
Dial-in: +1 650 555 0199

One more technical note for Emma: for the PoC we'll start with our 8-bit quantized variant to reduce token costs. Priyom will validate that model accuracy on your 120 prompts remains within the threshold you mentioned. If not, we'll fall back to the full-precision variant for the latency pass.

Looking forward to tomorrow — I'll record the session and share minutes within 24 hours.

— Ben
